rules.guidance: Don't use blocking `*Sync` fs/crypto calls on a hot/request path; use the async APIs so the event loop isn't stalled.
Every Promise / async call is awaited or has a `.catch`; an unhandled rejection can crash the process.
Honor error-first callbacks / propagate errors; don't swallow the `err` argument.
Respect stream backpressure (use `pipeline`/await `write` drain) instead of buffering unbounded data in memory.
Join user input into a path only after validating it stays within the intended root (path traversal).
Read config/secrets from env or a secret store, not hardcoded; validate required env at startup.
Avoid `process.exit()` in library/request code — it truncates pending I/O; throw or return instead.
